# Teaching Channel

> > Teaching Channel provides online continuing education courses and professional development resources for K-12 educators with graduate credit options and university partnerships.

Teaching Channel offers a comprehensive platform for teacher professional development, including continuing education courses for license renewal and salary advancement, advanced degree programs through partnerships with American College of Education and universities like Augustana and Roosevelt, and a K12 Hub with free educational resources. The platform features flexible course formats, payment plans, and group discounts to support educators at all stages of their careers.

## Key Topics

- Continuing Education
- Professional Development
- Graduate Credits
- License Renewal
- Salary Advancement
- American College of Education (ACE)
- Online Learning
- Course Bundles
- Science of Reading
- Social-Emotional Learning
- Artificial Intelligence in Education
- Teacher Training
- Payment Plans
- K12 Hub
- Differentiation

## Core Courses & Programs

- [Welcome to Teaching Channel](https://www.teachingchannel.com): Teaching Channel homepage featuring continuing education courses and professional development resources.
- [Continuing Education Courses for Teachers](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers): Main continuing education courses page with online courses, resources, and partnerships.
- [All Courses](https://courses.teachingchannel.com/courses/dl/all): Complete course catalog featuring all available online learning and graduate credit courses.
- [Fast Track Courses](https://www.teachingchannel.com/fasttrack): Fast Track program with graduate credits through ACE, Augustana, and Roosevelt University.
- [Advanced Degrees with ACE](https://www.teachingchannel.com/advanced-degrees): Master's and Doctorate programs through ACE partnership with 84% cost savings.
- [Certificates](https://www.teachingchannel.com/license-renewal-salary-advancement/certificates): Certificate programs for license renewal and salary advancement with ACE degrees.
- [Course Bundles](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers/course-bundles): Course bundles with savings including Fast Track and ACE 3-Course Bundle options.
- [Flex Credit Courses](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers/flex-credit-savings): Flex Credit Courses offering affordable professional development at lower pricing.

## Educational Resources & Community

- [K12 Hub](https://www.teachingchannel.com/k12-hub): K12 Hub offering free resources, blogs, ebooks, podcasts, and webinars for educators.

## Course Information & Planning

- [About Our Courses](https://www.teachingchannel.com/about-our-courses): Overview of course quality, accreditation partnerships, and university collaborations.
- [Course Topics](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers/course-topics): Directory of course topics including Science of Reading and instructional strategies.
- [Course Formats & Options](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers/course-formats): Guide to course formats and options for professional development advancement.
- [Term Options](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers/term-calendar): Term calendar and scheduling options including fast track and year-round courses.
- [University Partners & Transcripts](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers/university-partners-transcripts): Information on university partnerships and transcript processing with ACE and others.

## Pricing & Payment Options

- [Course Pricing & Payment Options](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers/course-pricing): Course pricing and payment options guide for professional development advancement.
- [Pay As You Learn Payment Plan](https://www.teachingchannel.com/continuing-education-courses-for-teachers/course-pricing/pay-as-you-learn-payment-plan): Pay As You Learn payment plan allowing up to 12 months to pay for courses.
- [Group Discounts](https://www.teachingchannel.com/group-discounts): Group discount information with payment plans and group leader incentives.
- [Discounts & Savings](https://www.teachingchannel.com/discounts-and-savings): Current discounts, promo codes, and savings opportunities for educators.
- [Purchase Order Registration](https://www.teachingchannel.com/purchase-order-registration): Purchase order registration guide for school cohorts and institutional purchasing.
